remove_RGOs = {
	# RGO buildings are placed through setup (main_menu/setup/start/98_mnt_rgo_setup.txt,
	# generated by tools/generators_from_game_data/generators/rgo_setup/rgo_setup.py),
	# so the engine fills
	# their workers before day one. This only removes the vanilla RGO jobs.
	every_owned_location = {
		change_max_raw_material_workers = -100
	}

	# Vacancy modifier no longer needed: setup places the RGO buildings with
	# their workers already converted from peasants.
	# add_country_modifier = {
	# 	modifier = fill_vacancies
	# 	months = 2
	# 	mode = add
	# 	desc = fill_vacancies_desc
	# }
}

REPLACE:cc_setup_new_town = {
	change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:RGO_building_clay	value = 1 }
	change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:RGO_building_lumber	value = 1 }
	change_building_level_in_location = { building = building_type:mason				value = 1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = mnt_fill_amount value = { value = 2 add = advanced_peasant_building_employment } }
	mnt_promote_pops = { from = pop_type:peasants to = pop_type:laborers amount = local_var:mnt_fill_amount }
	change_max_raw_material_workers = 1
	
	if = {
		limit = { market_access <= 0 }
	
		create_market = {
			builder = root
			location = scope:new_town
			price = price:create_market
			instant = yes
			price_modifier = 0
		}	
	}
}
